keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Barcelona 0, Rayo Vallecano 1. Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Álvaro García.
Goal! Barcelona 1, Rayo Vallecano 1. Raphinha (Barcelona) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Xavi Espart.
Goal! Barcelona 2, Rayo Vallecano 1. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Marc Bernal.
Delay in match because of an injury Jozhua Vertrouwd (Rayo Vallecano).
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Adrià Pedrosa replaces Jozhua Vertrouwd because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Barcelona 2, Rayo Vallecano 1.
Second Half begins Barcelona 2, Rayo Vallecano 1.
Own Goal by Florian Lejeune, Rayo Vallecano. Barcelona 3, Rayo Vallecano 1.
Delay in match (Barcelona).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Pedro Díaz replaces Gnangoro.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Fran Pérez replaces Jorge de Frutos.
Goal! Barcelona 3, Rayo Vallecano 2. Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Unai López with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Barcelona. Fermín López replaces Dani Olmo.
Substitution, Barcelona. Rodri replaces Marc Bernal.
Goal! Barcelona 4, Rayo Vallecano 2. Raphinha (Barcelona) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Anthony Gordon following a fast break.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Alemão replaces Sergio Camello.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Randy Nteka replaces Unai López.
Substitution, Barcelona. João Cancelo replaces Pedri.
Substitution, Barcelona. Karim Adeyemi replaces Anthony Gordon.
Substitution, Barcelona. Hamza Abdelkarim replaces Raphinha.
Adrià Pedrosa (Rayo Vallecano) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Barcelona 5, Rayo Vallecano 2. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Karim Adeyemi.
Second Half ends, Barcelona 5, Rayo Vallecano 2.

commentary.text: Attempt blocked. Pedri (Barcelona) left footed shot from outside the box is blocked. Assisted by Lamine Yamal.
